milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a prismarine brick slab with the provided iron pickaxe drops the slab item into the player's inventory. The player must break the slab blocking the doorway at spawn-relative (1, 1, 3). This rule type is preferred for mine tasks because the mined drop appearing in inventory is the most direct confirmation of successful mining. The scene provides an iron pickaxe (confirmed in sandbox preview step_010 showing mining cracks), which is required for stone-type blocks to drop their item.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate into the room (after mining the slab) and face the pink concrete block at spawn-relative (1, 0, 6). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the block (they must be inside or at the doorway of the 6x4 interior room). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking toward the pink concrete, not just standing nearby. The torch at (0, 1, 6) illuminates the target, confirmed visible in sandbox preview.
